data.item: Strategy Execution We rolled out new products that continued to edge us closer to being a one stop shop for all financial solutions. We also formed strategic partnerships that cemented our position in the market. We have invested in high quality systems that have continued to make it easier for our customers to engage with our products and services.

Performance Overview Performance improved year on year, though behind target, mainly affected by growth in loan provisions due to growth in NPA book, as economic activities slowed down. The impact of Government shifting its accounts from commercial banks to the central bank was the major reason for slow down in economic activities. Moreover, there has been a delay by the Government in releasing payments to its suppliers with the back log of invoices affecting some suppliers. The Government is still scrutinizing the long overdue invoices.
